name: Polish national offshore windfarm source record
abstract: Raw project records compiled from Polish national reporting. Retains the published input fields and has no source-provided geometry; a separate, explicit crosswalk can associate projects with EMODnet locations for the harmonized view.

transforms.description: Converts the Polish national offshore wind project compilation (CSV, gramwzielone.pl, 26 Aug 2026) into windfarm designated areas (`common-windfarm-designated-area`). The transformation is driven by the alignment declared in this block's `ontology.ttl`: `ns:columnMappings` maps the source columns (properties of this block's context) onto `owf:`, `schema:` and `dcterms:` properties with conversions, ordered value rules (e.g. status wording to the EMODnet status vocabulary) or constants. One row becomes one feature. The source has no coordinates; when the optional `crosswalk` and `emodnet_snapshot` are given, the project's EMODnet sites become `same_as` links and the geometry their centroid (`mapped`), or a documented approximate point (`anticipated`); otherwise the geometry is null (`unmatched`).

description:
# Polish national offshore windfarm source

This block describes the source-stage record exactly as delivered in the exercise CSV: `farm`, `developer`, `capacity_mw`, `status_aug2026`, `first_power_or_completion_year`, and `source`. Its source rows do **not** contain coordinates. Their geometry therefore remains null in the national-source collection.

The exercise applies the separate `location-mapping.json` crosswalk when it builds the harmonized service. Crosswalked locations are explicitly marked as derived from the listed EMODnet records; a project without a defensible EMODnet match remains unlocated.

examples.title: National source record without coordinates

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: Polish national offshore windfarm source feature
description: GeoJSON Feature wrapper for the national source row. Source property
  names and values are retained. The source has no coordinates; geometry is null until
  an explicit location crosswalk is applied in the harmonized target view.
type: object
required:
- id
- type
- geometry
- properties
properties:
  id:
    type: string
    x-jsonld-id: '@id'
  type:
    const: Feature
    x-jsonld-id: '@type'
  geometry:
    type: 'null'
    x-jsonld-id: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#geometry
  properties:
    type: object
    required:
    - farm
    - developer
    - capacity_mw
    - status_aug2026
    - first_power_or_completion_year
    - source
    properties:
      farm:
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: projectName
      developer:
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://schema.org/creator
      capacity_mw:
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: reportedCapacityMW
      status_aug2026:
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: reportedStatusAugust2026
      first_power_or_completion_year:
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: reportedFirstPowerOrCompletionYear
      source:
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://purl.org/dc/terms/source
    additionalProperties: false
    x-jsonld-id: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#properties
additionalProperties: false
x-jsonld-extra-terms:
  Feature: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#Feature
x-jsonld-vocab: https://w3id.org/ogc/hosted/seadots/national-windfarm-source/
x-jsonld-prefixes:
  geojson: https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#
